organisation: NovaTech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (fictional company for demo)

rules.text: User passwords must be at least 12 characters long.
Passwords must be changed at least every 90 days.
Multi-factor authentication must be enabled for all remote access.
rules.keywords: multi-factor authentication MFA two-factor remote access VPN

rules.text: Security incidents must be reported to the security team within 24 hours.
Personal data of employees must be encrypted at rest.
rules.keywords: personal data employee records encrypted encryption at rest

rules.text: Employee personal data must not be shared with third parties without written consent.
rules.keywords: share personal data third parties vendors consent

rules.text: A data breach involving personal data must be notified to affected employees within 72 hours.
rules.keywords: data breach notify affected employees personal data hours

rules.text: Financial records must be retained for at least 8 years.
rules.keywords: financial records invoices ledgers retain retention years archive

rules.text: CCTV footage must not be kept for more than 30 days.
rules.keywords: CCTV footage video surveillance kept stored deleted days

rules.text: Backups must be tested for restoration every quarter.
Fire drills must be conducted at least once every 6 months.
All workplace injuries must be recorded in the incident register.
rules.keywords: workplace injury accident recorded incident register

rules.text: Protective equipment must be worn in the server room and warehouse.
rules.keywords: protective equipment PPE helmet gloves warehouse server room worn

rules.text: Payments above Rs 5,00,000 must be approved by two authorised signatories.
rules.keywords: payment approval signatories approve amount dual

rules.text: Employee expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense.
Vendors must undergo an anti-bribery due diligence check before onboarding.
rules.keywords: vendor supplier onboarding due diligence anti-bribery check

rules.text: Access rights of departing employees must be revoked within 24 hours of exit.
rules.keywords: access rights revoked departing employee exit offboarding accounts disabled hours

rules.text: User access rights must be reviewed at least every 6 months.
rules.keywords: access review rights permissions reviewed months audit

rules.text: Shared or generic login accounts must not be used.
rules.keywords: shared generic login accounts credentials common
